annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1755 on detailed arrangements for the conduct of certain proceedings by the Commission pursuant to Regulation (EU) 2024/1689
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1755 on detailed arrangements for the conduct of certain proceedings by the Commission pursuant to Regulation (EU) 2024/1689
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: Commission Implementing Regulation setting procedural rules under the EU AI Act for evaluating general-purpose AI models (including model access and independent experts) and for fining proceedings against GPAI providers, covering access to file, confidentiality, written observations, limitation periods and transmission of documents.
key_provisions_or_claims: Commission decisions requesting GPAI model access specify technical means, and may include source code, weights and infrastructure access.
Independent experts must meet independence, confidentiality and security criteria; the Commission may terminate appointments.
Interim measures may be ordered before proceedings open, including preventing a model being made available.
Providers may submit written observations on preliminary findings (min. 21 days, 50-page limit) with access to file and confidentiality safeguards.
Five-year limitation periods apply to imposing and enforcing fines under Article 101(1).
